items.desc: Offset, who rose to fame alongside Quavo and Takeoff in the superstar Atlanta rap trio Migos, was one of the artists who remade the sound of hip-hop at the dawn of streaming in the 2010s and helped cement Atlanta as a center of rap innovation and success. He sat down with Joe and Jon to chat about musicmaking – his new solo album, “GMFU,” is out Nov. 13 – as well as some of his personal foibles and setbacks that have kept him in the public eye: his marriage to and split from Cardi B, getting shot outside a Florida casino and the 2022 murder of his close friend and collaborator Takeoff. items.title: Offset Pours His Heart Out: Takeoff, Cardi B, Gambling & Getting Shot

items.desc: Dominic Fike sat down with Joe and Jon to chat about his new album, “How To Quit Smoking,” as well as the recent success of his 2018 song “Babydoll,” which reached No. 10 on the Billboard Hot 100 — his biggest song to date. He also spoke about (sometimes happily) wrestling with fame’s temptations, letting go of some of his youthful impulses, and his urge to return to a form of music-making that reminded him of how he started out.
